note: Building and placement rules (roadmap item 50; core/game/game_build.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). The family house is the first base: a family may build only inside a claim round the home town (`base_place`), which grows with every level bought in the house (`radius_per_house_level`). A piece (`pieces`, the same four kinds GamePath walks: wall, floor, road, door) goes in one cell of the surface (layer y = -1) or of dug ground (y = 0 and down) and is paid for in the family's stores (`cost`, materials) and the heir's gold. Rules: a cell holds one piece; nothing is built on a tree or rock outcrop; a piece needs level ground (`max_slope`: the biggest step in height to a dry neighbour); only a floor or road may go over water and only as a bridge that reaches land within `max_span` tiles; a door needs a wall on each of two opposite sides (`needs_frame`) and the wall cannot be taken away while it hangs; underground a piece goes only into a cell that has been dug. A room is a region closed by walls (and doors) that is no bigger than `max_room_area`. Taking a piece down gives back `refund` of its cost. Nothing here is random, and the autopilot never builds.
